schema.description: A dose the person says they missed, as a point fact. Written into records files by hand, so far from a blood pressure diary's missed-medication mark.

date.description: The day the dose was missed, YYYY-MM-DD. This is the fact time.

id.description: Identity, chosen by the writer: the source's prefix and the date.

medication.description: Which medicine was missed, in free text. The diary that is the only source so far does not say; the writer filled it from the regimen another source shows on that day, drugs and strengths in words, and said which source. Not normalised to a drug name and not linked to a regimen series.
examples: examplazole 20 mg, the regimen on that date

note.description: The source's own words about the miss, verbatim: for the blood pressure diary, the tag its app printed beside each reading of that day.

source_note.description: Where the reader found the miss and what it rests on. Reader's text, not the source's.
